req.title: Echo request headers
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /headers with a JSON object whose 'headers' field mirrors the request headers received.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /headers must return a JSON object with a 'headers' field that mirrors the request headers. I designed tests covering: (1) positive EP — standard custom header is echoed exactly; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — single-character header value is echoed exactly; (4) DT — multiple custom headers all echoed simultaneously; (5) BVA — empty string header value at boundary; (6) EP — Host header always present in echo. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator, and key-name mutations.

tests.name: test_headers_echoes_custom_header_exactly
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /headers with custom header X-Test-Header: hello-world
trace: R-HTTPBIN-012: system shall respond with JSON whose 'headers' field mirrors request headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_headers_echoes_custom_header_exactly():
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'hello-world'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert data['headers']['X-Test-Header'] == 'hello-world'

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: headers['X-Custom-Value'] equals 'abc123XYZ' exactly — not truncated, not transformed
trace: R-HTTPBIN-012: mirrors request headers — value must be verbatim, catching any transform mutation
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_headers_header_value_not_mutated():
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'X-Custom-Value': 'abc123XYZ'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'headers' in data
    val = data['headers']['X-Custom-Value']
    assert val == 'abc123XYZ'
    assert val != 'abc123xy'
    assert val != ''
    assert len(val) == 9
